svg.title: Legacy and SegWit input structure
svg.desc: Both inputs have a previous txid, output index, scriptSig length, scriptSig, and sequence. Spending a P2PKH coin, the legacy scriptSig holds signature_A and K_A. Spending a P2WPKH coin, the SegWit scriptSig is empty, and the same items move to the witness structure, which holds one entry per input.
